name: pearcinema
description: Your self-hosted film and TV collection, playable anywhere. P2P video player with no port forwarding, no VPN and no account.
//: THE HOST HAS ITS OWN DEPENDENCY SET and it is deliberately small, because
almost everything it does is inherited from @peerloom/host: the HyperDHT
server, the firewall, pairing, the grant store, revoke and the media channel.
@peerloom/host is consumed as a file: dependency, matching how @peerloom/core
and @peerloom/device-link already work. It runs in NODE ON A SERVER, not in a
Bare worklet on a phone, so core's native-addon `overrides` block does NOT
apply and must not be copied here.
